text:
maya: prepping a small-night deploy for feature flag `llmroute_v3_toggle`. change window 23:30-01:30 UTC. plan: 1% canary in eu-west-1 at 23:30 -> wait 10m -> 5% -> wait 20m -> 25% -> wait 30m -> 100%. hold at steps until metrics green. model pinned to model-route v3.0.1 for this rollout. @deploybot queue this, @sre-oncall FYI.

deploybot: scheduled. will post each step and snapshots.

alex: rollback criteria: p95 > 500ms (5m) OR error-rate > 0.7% OR CPU > 75% sustained 5m. add semantic drift: customer-smoke eval delta > 3% -> rollback.

lin: add a manual holdpoint after 5% ramp to run quick A/B eval. also enforce quiet-window: no routing changes 23:00-02:00.

deploybot: rollback action configured: pin traffic to model-route v2.0.8 and set `llmroute_v3_toggle=off` for all cohorts. Ops rollback command:
```
/deploybot rollback llmroute_v3_toggle --pin v2.0.8
```

sre-oncall: standing by. will mute non-actionable alerts, monitor p95, error-rate, cpu, token-queue length, and eval pass/fail.

maya: thanks, team. i'll draft a brief release note and post once canary passes first hold.

deploybot: canary 1% executed at 23:30 UTC. metrics snapshot in ~8m.

alex: if canary OK at 23:40, proceed 5% at 23:45 and hold for manual eval at 23:55.

sre-oncall: snapshot (23:38): p95=290ms, error-rate=0.11%, cpu=52%. prelim green.

maya: good. will monitor APM and eval results.
